compute_policy: Experiments run in the container; GitHub is persistence/review/reproducibility only.
current_architecture: interface discovery/normalization -> active behavioral semantic grounding -> source applicability -> source-specific ABI/action adapter -> common action/state-transition distribution -> top-dominant sparse probability fusion -> program composition

core_results.private_tokenizer_abi: 15/15 codecs structurally recovered in three 64-state neural pools; held-out decode 17999/18000; hard depth1-5 4499/4500
core_results.heldout_transformer: MUL attention source absent from seen-only threshold calibration; three pools, threshold 0.65, route score 1.0 vs second 0.3, hard and probability 0.6/0.4 perfect at depth1-5

joint_integration.unlabeled_interface_corpus: five seen codes only across seven grammar skeletons
joint_integration.fix: learn full command-placeholder grammar skeletons and use structural distance; local bigrams only tie-break

shadow_source_identifiability_boundary.shadow_function: matches fixed ten ADD probes exactly; otherwise differs on about 24.7% of the 32x32 domain
shadow_source_identifiability_boundary.decision: fixed finite anchors are insufficient as a semantic proof; use disagreement-driven active behavioral identification when candidate sources remain observationally ambiguous

negative_boundaries.arbitrary_whole_action_random_codebook: does not few-shot generalize to unseen actions
negative_boundaries.fixed_behavior_probe_set: can be spoofed by an observationally equivalent shadow source
